WITH event_stats AS (
  SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) as avg_anlycount,
    AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) as avg_ownership_diff
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_diff) as overall_diff
  FROM event_stats
)
SELECT
  es.corpeventprx,
  es.avg_anlycount,
  es.avg_ownership_diff,
  es.avg_ownership_diff - oa.overall_diff as diff_from_overall
FROM event_stats es
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE oa.overall_diff IS NOT NULL
